definition: One of two thin sticks used for eating Asian food.
examples: She picked up the rice with chopsticks.
Could I have a pair of chopsticks?

spanish.definition: Uno de dos palos delgados para comer comida asiática.

definition: A kitchen tool with small holes for draining liquid.
examples: Pour the pasta into a strainer.
Use a strainer for the tea.
The strainer is in the sink.

spanish.definition: Utensilio de cocina con huecos para sacar el líquido.

definition: A tool for opening wine bottles.
examples: He opened the bottle with a corkscrew.
The corkscrew is in the drawer.

spanish.definition: Herramienta para abrir botellas de vino.

definition: A tool for opening cans or bottles; the first game.
examples: There's a bottle opener on the fridge.
The team won the season opener.

spanish.definition: Herramienta para abrir latas o botellas; primer juego.

definition: A spicy sausage often used on pizza.
examples: She took the pepperoni off her slice.

spanish.definition: Salchicha picante muy usada en pizza.

definition: A salty Italian sausage.

spanish.definition: Salchicha italiana salada.

definition: A spicy Mexican sauce; a Latin dance.
examples: She takes salsa lessons on Tuesdays.

spanish.definition: Salsa mexicana picante; baile latino.

definition: A green sauce made from avocados.
examples: Do you want guacamole on your taco?

spanish.definition: Salsa verde hecha de aguacate.

definition: A soft food made from chickpeas.
examples: I had hummus with pita bread.
We bought a tub of hummus.

spanish.definition: Comida suave hecha de garbanzos.

definition: A sweet you chew but don't swallow; the pink skin around your teeth.
examples: Do you want a piece of gum?

spanish.definition: Dulce que masticas sin tragar; piel rosada alrededor de los dientes.

definition: A strong alcoholic drink from sugar.
examples: Cuba is famous for its rum.
This cake has rum in it.

spanish.definition: Bebida alcohólica fuerte hecha de azúcar.

definition: A strong alcoholic drink from Mexico.
examples: He drank a shot of tequila.

spanish.definition: Bebida alcohólica fuerte de México.

definition: Making you feel strong emotion; changing position.
examples: It was a very moving speech.
Don't jump from a moving car.
The movie's ending is very moving.

spanish.definition: Que te hace sentir mucha emoción; que cambia de posición.

definition: The direction between south and west.
examples: The wind is from the southwest.
We drove southwest for an hour.

spanish.definition: Dirección entre el sur y el oeste.

definition: The direction between south and east.

spanish.definition: Dirección entre el sur y el este.

definition: The direction between north and east.
examples: Winters are cold in the northeast.
The town is northeast of Bogotá.

spanish.definition: Dirección entre el norte y el este.

definition: The direction between north and west.
examples: It rains a lot in the Northwest.
The city is northwest of here.

spanish.definition: Dirección entre el norte y el oeste.

definition: Toward the bottom of a hill.
examples: Things have gone downhill since he left.

spanish.definition: Hacia la parte de abajo de una colina.

definition: A man who opens the door at a hotel or a building.
examples: The doorman called us a taxi.

spanish.definition: Hombre que abre la puerta de un hotel o un edificio.

definition: A person with red hair.
examples: The tall redhead is my cousin.

spanish.definition: Persona de pelo rojo.

definition: The land next to the sea.
examples: We spent a week at the seaside.

spanish.definition: Tierra junto al mar.

definition: The back of a horse.
examples: We went horseback riding in the mountains.
He toured the farm on horseback.

spanish.definition: Lomo de un caballo.

definition: A school book with photos of students.
examples: I found my old high school yearbook.
My photo in the yearbook is terrible.

spanish.definition: Libro escolar con fotos de los estudiantes.

definition: The time when it gets dark.
examples: The town was quiet at nightfall.

spanish.definition: Momento en que oscurece.

definition: A short message on social media; to post this message.

spanish.definition: Mensaje corto en redes sociales; publicar este mensaje.

definition: To write something again in a better way.
examples: I had to rewrite my paper.
She rewrote the ending of the book.

spanish.definition: Escribir algo otra vez de mejor manera.

definition: To make someone conscious again; to bring back to life.

spanish.definition: Hacer que alguien recobre el conocimiento; traer de vuelta a la vida.

definition: To discover something secret; to take a cover off.
examples: Uncover the pot and stir the soup.

spanish.definition: Descubrir algo secreto; quitar una cubierta.

definition: To obey a rule or a request.
examples: You must comply with the law.
The company is complying with the new rules.

spanish.definition: Obedecer una regla o un pedido.

definition: To clap your hands to show you liked something.
examples: The audience applauded for five minutes.

spanish.definition: Golpear las manos para mostrar que algo te gustó.

definition: To shine with small flashes of light.
examples: The lake sparkled in the sun.

spanish.definition: Relucir con pequeños destellos de luz.

definition: To make a long, loud cry, like a wolf.
examples: The wolves howled at the moon.

spanish.definition: Hacer un grito largo y fuerte, como un lobo.

definition: To have control over someone or something.
examples: He tries to dominate his wife.
Big companies are dominating the market.

spanish.definition: Tener control sobre alguien o algo.

definition: To become rotten; the process of going bad.
examples: The dentist found some tooth decay.

spanish.definition: Pudrirse; proceso de dañarse.

definition: To send a signal or a disease.
examples: The radio is transmitting a message.

spanish.definition: Enviar una señal o pasar una enfermedad.

definition: To stop sleeping, or to wake someone.
examples: She awakened to the sound of rain.
The trip awakened his love of travel.

spanish.definition: Dejar de dormir, o despertar a alguien.

definition: To hit something and make a low sound.
examples: He thumped the table with his hand.
The music is thumping next door.

spanish.definition: Pegarle a algo y hacer un sonido bajo.

definition: To move things illegally into a country.
examples: They smuggled drugs across the border.
He tried to smuggle cigarettes on the plane.
Gangs are smuggling people into the country.

spanish.definition: Mover cosas ilegalmente a un país.

definition: To stop something from being seen or from growing.
examples: She tried to suppress a smile.

spanish.definition: Evitar que algo se vea o crezca.

definition: To win in the end.

spanish.definition: Ganar al final.

definition: To ignore something.

spanish.definition: No prestarle atención a algo.

definition: To change the time of something.
examples: The game was rescheduled for Sunday.

spanish.definition: Cambiar la hora de algo.

definition: To enter a place or a situation where you aren't wanted.
examples: Reporters were intruding on the family.

spanish.definition: Entrar en un lugar o una situación donde no te quieren.

definition: To refuse to do what you are told.
examples: The kids are disobeying the rules.

spanish.definition: Negarse a hacer lo que te dicen.

examples: Everyone is scrambling to finish on time.

spanish.definition: Moverse rápido con las manos; mezclar huevos al cocinar.

definition: To make information public.
examples: The company didn't disclose the price.
She refused to disclose her name.

spanish.definition: Hacer pública una información.

definition: To make someone afraid.
examples: He tried to intimidate the witness.

spanish.definition: Hacer que alguien tenga miedo.

definition: To make a long, low sound.

spanish.definition: Hacer un sonido largo y bajo.

definition: To force someone to do something; to help.
examples: The law obliges you to pay.

spanish.definition: Hacer que alguien tenga que hacer algo; ayudar.

definition: To pay for a loss; to balance something bad.
examples: The airline compensated us for the delay.
Nothing can compensate for losing a child.
We're compensating you for your time.

spanish.definition: Pagar por una pérdida; equilibrar algo malo.

definition: To feel sad because someone has died.

spanish.definition: Sentir tristeza porque alguien murió.

definition: To say something aloud from memory.

spanish.definition: Decir algo en voz alta de memoria.

definition: A long, hard walk; to make such a walk.
examples: We went on a three-day trek.

spanish.definition: Caminata larga y difícil; hacer esa caminata.

definition: To hit with a beak; a quick kiss.
examples: The chickens pecked at the corn.
She gave him a peck on the cheek.
The bird is pecking at the window.

spanish.definition: Golpear con el pico; beso rápido.

definition: To let yourself enjoy something special.
examples: I indulged in a big piece of cake.
We're indulging in a nice dinner.

spanish.definition: Permitirte disfrutar algo especial.

definition: To try to prove in court that someone is guilty.
examples: The state is prosecuting the case.

spanish.definition: Tratar de probar en un juicio que alguien es culpable.

definition: To begin.
examples: The ceremony will commence at noon.

spanish.definition: Empezar.

definition: To get rid of something.
examples: He disposed of the old batteries.
We're disposing of the old furniture.

spanish.definition: Deshacerse de algo.

definition: To move slowly from side to side.
examples: The trees swayed in the wind.
The crowd swayed to the music.
The boat is swaying on the water.

spanish.definition: Moverse lentamente de lado a lado.

definition: To die, especially in a disaster.
examples: The crops are perishing from lack of rain.

spanish.definition: Morir, sobre todo en un desastre.

definition: To take off your clothes.
examples: The doctor asked me to undress.

spanish.definition: Quitarte la ropa.

definition: Connected to the voice; expressing opinions strongly.
examples: He's a vocal critic of the mayor.
The band has a new vocal coach.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con la voz; que expresa opiniones con fuerza.

definition: Protected from the sun; not honest.
examples: We sat in a shady spot.

spanish.definition: Protegido del sol; deshonesto.

definition: Often changing how you feel.

spanish.definition: Que cambia a menudo de ánimo.

definition: Seeming evil or dangerous.
examples: The house looked sinister at night.

spanish.definition: Que parece malvado o peligroso.

definition: Unable to do a job well.
examples: The company hired an incompetent manager.

spanish.definition: Que no puede hacer bien un trabajo.

definition: Like metal.
examples: I have a metallic taste in my mouth.

spanish.definition: Parecido al metal.

definition: Connected to poetry; beautiful.
examples: He has a poetic way of speaking.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con la poesía; bonito.

definition: Very serious.
examples: The funeral was a solemn event.
She looked at me with a solemn face.

spanish.definition: Muy serio.

definition: About to happen.

spanish.definition: A punto de pasar.

definition: Strange in a funny way.
examples: My aunt is a little eccentric.

spanish.definition: Raro de una manera chistosa.

definition: Very strong and a little scary.

spanish.definition: Muy fuerte y un poco aterrador.

definition: Connected to race.
examples: The city has a lot of racial diversity.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con la raza.

definition: Able to be heard.
examples: The music was audible from the street.

spanish.definition: Que se puede oír.

definition: Very great or excellent.
examples: The team had a phenomenal season.

spanish.definition: Muy grande o excelente.

definition: Rude and not showing respect.
examples: Don't be disrespectful to your teacher.

spanish.definition: Grosero y sin mostrar respeto.

definition: Having a secret relationship with another person.
examples: He was unfaithful to his wife.
She found out he was unfaithful.
An unfaithful husband ruined their marriage.

spanish.definition: Que tiene una relación secreta con otra persona.

definition: Not based on reason.
examples: She has an irrational fear of birds.

spanish.definition: Que no se basa en la razón.

definition: Connected to math.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con las matemáticas.

definition: Connected to a bride.
examples: She went to a bridal shop.
The bridal party arrived at noon.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con una novia.

definition: Silly and too sentimental.

spanish.definition: Tonto y demasiado sentimental.

definition: Very clear, often in a violent way; connected to drawing.
examples: He gave a graphic description of the crash.

spanish.definition: Muy claro, a menudo violento; relacionado con el dibujo.

definition: Very strong and focused.
examples: I took an intensive English course.

spanish.definition: Muy fuerte y concentrado.

definition: Dry and with no plants.
examples: We drove through a barren desert.
Nothing grows on this barren hill.

spanish.definition: Seco y sin plantas.

definition: Good for growing plants; able to have babies.
examples: The soil here is very fertile.

spanish.definition: Bueno para cultivar plantas; capaz de tener bebés.

spanish.definition: Hecho por las personas, no natural.

definition: Loving your country.
examples: She wore a patriotic shirt on July 4.

spanish.definition: Que ama su país.

definition: From the air.
examples: We took an aerial photo of the farm.
The army began an aerial attack.

spanish.definition: Desde el aire.

definition: Able to work or to succeed.
examples: Solar power is a viable option.

spanish.definition: Capaz de funcionar o tener éxito.

definition: Not important.
examples: It's an insignificant amount of money.

spanish.definition: Que no es importante.

definition: Very small.

spanish.definition: Muy pequeño.

definition: Not deep; only on the surface.

spanish.definition: Que no es profundo; solo en la superficie.

definition: Strange or amazing.
examples: The view from the top is unreal.

spanish.definition: Raro o asombroso.

definition: Soft, relaxed, and pleasant.

spanish.definition: Suave, relajado y agradable.

definition: Causing huge damage.

spanish.definition: Que causa un daño enorme.

definition: Supporting new ideas; happening little by little.

spanish.definition: Que apoya ideas nuevas; que pasa poco a poco.

definition: Afraid.
examples: People are fearful of losing their jobs.

spanish.definition: Con miedo.

definition: Not well known; hard to understand.
examples: They found an obscure town in Spain.

spanish.definition: Que no se conoce mucho; difícil de entender.

definition: Connected to a colony.
examples: They live in an old colonial house.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con una colonia.

definition: Clever and funny.

spanish.definition: Inteligente y chistoso.
